_comment: Timeline documents and whether they render. Run through modules/timeline.py validate (tests/test_editor_doc_cases.py) and command-center/lib/editor.ts validateTimeline (command-center/tests/editor-timeline.test.ts): the two validators must agree on every case. A case with "assets" (asset id -> its kind in the project's organization, or "other_org") is also judged on its files: timeline.resolve_assets in Python, docAssetProblems in TypeScript, and 'valid' is the verdict of both checks together. "sql" is what the database's own check, editor_doc_problem (migration 0054), answers for it (tests/security/test_sec_editor_audio.py): it guards which organization a file belongs to, not which track it is on, so a file of the right organization on the wrong track reads null there and is refused by the other two layers.
